Subject: Re: PayGrid model fit eval - next steps

Hi Sofia / Daniel - thanks again for the call today. Quick recap + next steps so we're aligned:

Summary from today
- Your primary goal: improve customer support routing & response synthesis for high-value merchant questions with strict latency targets (< 300ms p95).
- Current proprietary baseline: PG-Gen-Prod-v2 (internal to PayGrid) with high quality but expensive infra.
- Evaluation focus: answer accuracy / F1 for extraction tasks, hallucination rate, latency, and cost per 1M tokens.

Agreed next steps
1) We'll share a first-pass benchmark and the prompt set we used for parity testing by EOD Thurs (Dec 3). See link below.
2) You'll validate acceptance thresholds internally and confirm whether +/-3% absolute delta on the extraction F1 is acceptable versus PG-Gen-Prod-v2.
3) If parity looks promising, plan a 30-minute technical review week of Dec 7-10 to go over failure modes and rollout options (dedicated vs hosted).

Recommended models (initial candidates) 
- Open: Llama-3-13B-q4f16 - good balance of quality/latency when quantized; likely ~2-4% F1 gap on extraction tasks vs PG baseline.
- Open: Mistral-7B-int8 - very competitive on cost; may need prompt engineering for hallucination sensitivity.
- Proprietary candidate: Redwood-Prod-xl (our internal tuned variant) - expected to beat open models on strict hallucination and edge-case prompts but at higher cost.

Acceptance guidance
- For initial roll: target <= 3% absolute drop in F1 and no more than 10% regression in hallucination incidents on the evaluation prompt set. If either is exceeded, we recommend staged canary with human-in-the-loop.

Deliverables we'll attach
- prompt_sets_v1.json: the exact prompts & evaluator scripts we used.
- parity-benchmarks.xlsx: summary metrics (F1, Precision, Recall, hallucination rate, latency).
- paygrid_eval_results.zip: full artifacts + logs.

Can you confirm the acceptance thresholds and availability for a technical review Dec 7-10?

Thanks,
Lauren Bishop
Senior Solutions Manager | Redwood Inference
lauren_bishop@redwood.ai
phone: (415) 555-0124

---
Attachment stubs: prompt_sets_v1.json (application/json), parity-benchmarks.xlsx (spreadsheet), paygrid_eval_results.zip (zip)

We'll confirm the Dec 7-10 slot by EOD Friday. Looking forward to the artifacts.

Sofia - attaching the artifacts now (links + attachments). Quick notes to guide you through the set:

- prompt_sets_v1.json contains:
  * extraction_prompts_v1 (200 examples)
  * response_synthesis_prompts (100 examples)
  * sensitive_content_slice (25 examples) - per your ask

- parity-benchmarks.xlsx contains per-model tabs: metrics (F1/Precision/Recall), hallucination counts, latency distribution, cost estimates.

- paygrid_eval_results.zip contains raw model outputs, evaluation logs, and the scripts we ran (run_eval.sh).

High level finding (very preliminary):
- Llama-3-13B-q4f16: ~2.8% F1 drop on extraction tasks; hallucination incidents +6% (concentrated on rare merchant-edge prompts); p95 latency ~340ms on our hosted run (so slightly above target).
- Mistral-7B-int8: ~3.5% F1 drop; hallucination +4%; p95 latency ~270ms. Lower cost but quality gap larger on edge cases.
- Redwood-Prod-xl: parity or small improvement on F1; hallucination -2%; latency ~320ms on our hosted config but can be improved in Dedicated with GPU packing.

Immediate recommendation: run a latency-optimized hosted job (shorter context, KV cache warmup) and a Dedicated probe for Llama-3-13B to see if quantized latency can meet p95 300ms. We'll run those tests and share updated results by Dec 5 EOD.

Link to drive folder: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2b-paygrid-eval
HubSpot deal: https://hubspot.com/deal/PG-2026-11-33

Let us know if you want the raw outputs in a different format.

Cheers,
Lauren

Subject: Re: PayGrid model fit eval - parity checks & regression notes

Looping in a few technical notes before we run the Dedicated probe:

- Regression detection: we should add the following checks to the eval harness before the next run:
  1) Per-slice F1 on sensitive_content_slice; flag if delta > 1.5%
  2) Hallucination severity scoring (0/1/2) instead of binary counts to capture impact on business flow
  3) Token-level latency breakdown for KV cache cold vs warmed runs (p50/p95)

- Acceptance threshold proposal (engineering view):
  * Extraction F1: <= 2% absolute drop for initial canary to be considered safe for 10% of traffic.
  * Hallucination severity: no increase in severity-2 incidents.
  * End-to-end p95 latency: <= 300ms in Dedicated probe; <= 340ms tolerated for hosted with fallback enabled.

I attached parity-benchmarks.xlsx with updated per-slice numbers and a notes tab with failing examples. Aditya - can you run the Dedicated probe for Llama-3-13B quantized and drop the run artifacts into paygrid_eval_results.zip by EOD?

Thanks,
Marissa
